what: Verbatim source archive of the candidate upstream framework cited in the paper (gradient-clip default and CTC normalisation semantics).
upstream_lineage: signjoey-derived code base (neccam/slt, the Sign Language Transformers codebase, whose public history ends in 2020); this repository is an independent public repo last pushed 2025-04-27, i.e. contemporaneous with the SLRTP2025 release. It is NOT a GitHub fork of neccam/slt (no parent link); the correspondence is at file/code level.
licence: Apache-2.0 (repository LICENSE file, included verbatim). Redistribution with attribution permitted.
excluded_from_archive: base_annotations/ (PHOENIX-2014T annotation pickles; RWTH Aachen licence, not redistributed)
untracked working-tree files (git archive of the commit is authoritative)

load_bearing_files.signjoey/builders.py: build_gradient_clipper: returns None (no clipping) when neither clip_grad_val nor clip_grad_norm is present in the training config; clip_grad_val -> clip_grad_value_ (value clipping); clip_grad_norm -> clip_grad_norm_ (norm clipping); the two are mutually exclusive.
load_bearing_files.signjoey/training.py: _train_batch: translation loss divided by num_seqs (translation_normalization: batch) * batch_multiplier; recognition (CTC) loss divided by batch_multiplier only (=1), i.e. raw sum; developer comment '# TODO (Cihan): Add Gloss Token normalization (?)' at the recognition-loss normalisation site.
load_bearing_files.run_train.sh: training entry point of the candidate upstream (the released SLRTP2025 evaluation repository ships no training script).
